about: station-stats's application mutants (wf10 1BRC): edits of the example that its laws do not see; TestStationStatsAgrees in cmd/ergo (the seeded property against the reference and the hand Go control) kills each.

mutants.name: station-stats-fast-path-accepts-bad-temperature
mutants.rule: The fast path takes a line only when its temperature has the form -?d?d.d; any other line goes to the byte parser, which reports it.

mutants.name: station-stats-long-name-compare-stops-at-16
mutants.rule: Two stations longer than 16 bytes with the same first 16 bytes and length are one station only when all their bytes agree.

mutants.name: station-stats-split-cuts-a-line
mutants.to: for false && at < text.Len() && at > 0 && text[at-1] != '\n' {
mutants.rule: Every chunk starts at a line start, so no line is split between two workers.

mutants.name: station-stats-reduce-keeps-one-chunk
mutants.rule: A station's Stats is the Merge of its Stats in every chunk.
